amendment_1.note: time-box rule gave n = 40 (floor). Superseded by amendment 2 because 40 trials x 164 s x 2 models + Phase O/P does not fit the remaining wall-clock on the RTX 2000 Ada (16 GB) pod (planned: A4500 20 GB).

amendment_2.made_before: any C3 / C5 / ALT-4 statistic and any per-trial SCORE statistic (only original-model O1/O3 descriptive rates had been logged)
amendment_2.per_trial_s: s1 (first-token readout) instead of multi-token s; multi-token s kept on all SCORE-400 blocks (original, selected)
amendment_2.random_edits: norm-matched random edits scored on Heretic objective + first-token KL (SEL/EVAL) + s1; no TRIAL-PROBE generation
amendment_2.rank_k: raw Arditi variant ran on Gemma and destroyed the model (KL 20-53 nats; even random R5); projected variant only post hoc if time permits
amendment_2.rationale: plan F3 cut order (5) probe R-gen 50+50 already applied; (6) n_trials floor 40 cannot be met -> 30 equal across models, disclosed as below-plan; generation length 40 tokens and s1 are additional reduced readouts forced by measured throughput (~0.6 s per decode step for NF4 12B)

amendment_3.made_before: any C3 / C5 / ALT-4 statistic (attempt-3 trials 1-2 were logged but are discarded; study restarted from an empty journal so that the 25 seeded TPE start-up draws stay paired with GaMS)
amendment_3.random_edits: Heretic keyword refusals only for random direction j=1; Heretic KL + SEL/EVAL KL + s1 for all 5
amendment_3.mech_c: deferred to a post-chain step, only if time remains
amendment_3.gemma_replay_check: skipped in the final Gemma process; passed identically in attempts 2 and 3 (same model, same code)
amendment_3.rationale: measured t_trial = 148 s even with 40-token probe generation and s1; prefill of long RefusEU prompts dominates. 20 trials x 2 models is the maximum that fits with Phase O/P for both models. All 20 trials are TPE start-up (random) trials: C3 therefore reads as a paired random-edit design, and the selection rule acts on a random-search front.
